stories.title: Thanksgiving travel could create road delays up to 40 minutes in Utah, UDOT warns
stories.summary: Utah transportation officials warn that Thanksgiving travel could cause up to 25- to 40-minute delays on some sections of I-15 this week.

stories.title: Pope Francis' private diary describes a profound spiritual crisis and encounters with the devil
stories.summary: The Vatican has released excerpts of Pope Francis' private diary, to being published in several languages around the world on Tuesday.

stories.title: Longtime Utah high school sports official Jeff Cluff on life support after stroke
stories.summary: Utah High School Activities Association Associate Director Jeff Cluff, 49, is on life support after suffering a stroke last week.

stories.title: Utah AG moves to dismiss charges against Kalshi after it blocks service in state
stories.summary: Utah's attorney general has filed a court motion to dismiss criminal charges against Kalshi, after the prediction market company blocked access to its service in the state.

stories.title: Look inside the Utah prison plate plant — producing record license plate options
stories.summary: Utah's license plate options are made inside the Utah State Correctional Facility at an astounding pace. KSL News takes you inside.

stories.title: Provo food bank closure leaves gaps as community steps up to help
stories.summary: The closure of Community Action Services in Provo has left some families seeking food assistance. Alpine School District pantries are also declining because they relied on the food bank.

stories.title: Police fatally shoot man during domestic violence call in South Jordan
stories.summary: A man who allegedly threatened a woman with a gun and would not allow her to leave was shot and killed following a confrontation with a SWAT team.

stories.title: Box Elder County sheriff appears in court in automobile homicide case
stories.summary: Box Elder County Sheriff Kevin Potter made his first appearance in court in an automobile homicide case stemming from an Oct. 27 crash in Ogden.

stories.title: Trump will give Medal of Freedom to Giuliani, a fierce political ally who led New York through 9/11
stories.summary: President Donald Trump on Tuesday will award the Medal of Freedom, the nation's highest civilian honor, to former New York Mayor Rudy Giuliani.

stories.title: Utah law letting immigrant university students pay lower in-state tuition could be targeted again
stories.summary: The law letting immigrant students pay lower in-state tuition at Utah universities could again be targeted during the 2027 legislative session.

stories.title: Utah gas prices drop sharply over past month as economist predicts additional decline
stories.summary: Gas prices are dropping, and an economist said Monday he believed the trend would continue into January, even as drivers said they were still paying too much to fill up their vehicles.

stories.title: Trump will offer Thanksgiving pardons for turkeys Freedom and Feathers at the White House
stories.summary: Two turkeys named Freedom and Feathers are set to get Thanksgiving pardons from President Donald Trump on Tuesday.
